finding: The audit indexes 225 prior/shared files and 45,449 physical lines. It distinguishes source-backed current facts, derived code/output and stale/unsupported inputs; a line index is not a claim every legacy value was freshly re-fetched.
impact: Do not treat the repository's earlier pages as one fully current, independently certified dataset.
action: Use this release's canonical Week 10 files; inspect the line audit for legacy findings; preserve prior ownership.

finding: No official, validated player/string-slot-to-points coefficient was found. Injury-adjusted spread/total columns are blank for all Week 10 games.
impact: Current own lines are base, pre-injury baselines and may be materially wrong where a starter is absent.
action: Calibrate only from time-stamped actives, snaps and out-of-sample results; otherwise retain blanks.

finding: Official club depth-chart pages are often labeled unofficial; they are a listed order, not final participation or snap share. Houston's fetched chart was image-only and its string assignments are unverified.
impact: A listed backup cannot be represented as a confirmed replacement or active player.
action: Keep actual active and participation fields blank until final official reports/game logs are reconciled.

finding: The tracker contains 76 selected report/depth observations across 17 teams, not an exhaustive 32-team injury ledger. It includes practice DNP/LP statuses and some named starters; those statuses are not all game-day designations.
impact: A player/team absent from the table is not inferred healthy.
action: Complete team-by-team weekly report and final inactive reconciliation before use.

topic: Week 10 market quote timestamp and freshness
finding: The 28 DraftKings/FanDuel game quotes were captured with date 2026-11-12 but no UTC time or jurisdiction. Follow-up official-page fetches on 2026-11-13 displayed NE@DET DraftKings spread/total +3/49.5 versus +2.5/51.5 in the stored row, and a FanDuel total of 49.5 versus 50.5 in the stored row. These are later page displays; without matching capture time and jurisdiction they do not establish a comparable price move.
impact: The date-only rows are historical observations, not current/executable prices; comparability, exact time of any change, and the intervening price path cannot be established.
action: Keep quotes labeled date-only and out of CLV/current-line claims; preserve the old capture and obtain authorized timestamped operator quotes with jurisdiction before economic evaluation.

finding: Player leaders pages are aggregate and paginated; no paired official player-game outcomes were joined to exact prop prices and settlements.
impact: No player-prop combo probability, correlation, EV or fair price is calculated.
action: Acquire official/authorized paired game logs and settlement/price history; all numerical prop fields remain blank until then.

finding: No cross-game or same-game joint settlement ledger, exact parlay price history or void rules are stored.
impact: No parlay probability or ranking can be validated.
action: Block parlay strategy qualification until joint outcomes and actual prices are available.

finding: The simple no-HFA PF/G + opponent PA/G estimator was evaluated over 120 Week 2-9 games from one 2026 season. MAE=10.4048, r=0.135006, p=0.141514, naive 95% Fisher interval [-0.045336,0.306826].
impact: One-season within-sample accuracy does not establish profitability or skill; interval does not adjust for shared team/week dependence.
action: Treat as descriptive only; require prospective multiple-season holdout, calibrated probabilities and clustered uncertainty.

finding: The three standings correlations are cross-sectional team-level associations with shared inputs; CORR-04 is a one-season game-level forecast association. Player prop correlations are blank.
impact: These values do not represent causal effects, independent validation or an edge.
action: Label descriptive, disclose p/CI/n and dependence limitations; no player correlation claim.

finding: No complete authorized historical price, closing-price, bet selection, settlement, push/void or fee ledger was supplied for current qualification.
impact: ROI, CLV, expected value and skill score stay blank.
action: Do not inherit older backtests as current proof; register and archive all trials before outcomes.

finding: Earlier data files point to ESPN for market/futures values; ESPN is not an official sportsbook price archive, and some old line attributions are disputed by the line-lab review.
impact: Legacy prices and favorite/underdog attribution are not used in current lines.
action: Use only source-linked official sportsbook quotes with capture time, or leave market fields blank.

finding: Older backtest input includes Spreadspoke/GitHub and nflverse/Kaggle derived datasets; this session did not reconstruct each historical row from official NFL pages.
impact: Older strategy ROI/hit-rate summaries remain unverified historical research, not a qualified leaderboard.
action: Rebuild from official archived game/market records or keep those results flagged and out of the ranking.

finding: NFL.com Week 1 schedule uses a 'Sunday Night Football, September 9th' header while the same official schedule row dates NE@SEA on Wednesday, Sep. 9, 2026.
impact: Date/title metadata in old records may conflict even when score and matchup reconcile.
action: Canonical game CSV uses the date shown in the game record and flags the source-label anomaly for manual review.

topic: Potential team/player mismatch on NFL news page
finding: The Nov. 11 NFL roundup places the name Myles Garrett in the Rams injury section, while the Rams chart does not list him; the identity/team association is inconsistent with the clubs' official charts.
impact: The mention is excluded from the Rams depth deficiency table and no point impact is assigned.
action: Confirm the official club/player identity and any correction; do not assign him to LA pending resolution.

finding: San Francisco's LCB2 and Pittsburgh's LOLB2/DT2 are blank on the fetched official charts; Colts LS2 and Miami K are also blank.
impact: A replacement slot cannot be verified from the HTML chart.
action: Leave the replacement/slot blank and check the club's current written update; do not fill from a third-party depth chart.

finding: No preregistered smallest useful effect, power calculation, cluster unit or family of attempted tests has been approved.
impact: A numerical qualifying sample size is intentionally blank; fixed rules would be project policy, not official NFL standards.
action: Approve a prospective design before collecting new outcomes; apply multiplicity correction to every registered test.

finding: No funded prize amount, competition charter, eligibility audit or payment process was verified.
impact: Leaderboard ranks and rewards are blank; no reward is issued or promised.
action: Select and fund a competition policy and jurisdiction review before accepting entries.

finding: Base line uses only team PF/G and opponent PA/G; HFA is set to zero. It omits turnover, pace, EPA, rest/travel, weather, game-state, quarterback certainty and player availability.
impact: Simple baseline may be biased and poorly calibrated; this is not a fair line or pick.
action: Add features only with timestamped official/authorized inputs and validate out-of-sample; continue to disclose all omissions.

topic: No final inactive list yet in Wednesday snapshot
finding: The Week 10 injury evidence was a Wednesday, Nov. 11 status snapshot before most scheduled Week 10 games, not a final game-day active/inactive list.
impact: Participation and starting roles can change after capture.
action: Refresh after the official final report for each game and preserve the old snapshot rather than overwrite it.

finding: The existing root navigation and prior dashboards are owner/CI scoped; this release stays isolated.
impact: Dashboard may require an additional click from the repository landing page.
action: Review SUG-01 A/B/C and record a decision before shared-root edits.
